doc: Exploration hotspots of L_C4P2_Berlin (Level._merge_explore_hotspots; scene.json wins on name clashes). Owner: exploration stream (documentation/C4P2_DESIGN.md §4.2/§6). Every spot keeps >= 24 px from the story hotspots and NPC anchors of §4.2, >= 14 px from the other finds, >= 20 px from the spawns, and lies in the walk area of the scene that reaches it: x 30-892 = scene A (Ostbahnhof, Korridorbahnsteig K, Konrad, Monday evening, open until c4f_inspect_book), x 944-1895 = scene B (courtyard of Kolonnenstraße 14, Konrad, Tuesday night, open after c4f_inspect_book). `info` is the art contract for env-berlin: stand = where Konrad stands (feet line y 300), focus = where the thing is painted (world px), what = what must be visible there (positions follow the scenery of §4.2 left to right; an env stream may move a spot a few px with its art and then edits only the numbers here). The chats stand on NPC anchors of the story stream (marta_buffet, kuhnert_gate, hanna_yard) and need no entry here; the side task's voice from the window is Frau Grabowski's (no figure in the walk band). The engine reads only `hotspots` / `spawns`.

exp_liaison_booth.what: the glass booth at the barrier to platform K (x 5-60): two officials at one desk under one lamp, a Soviet liaison officer with a tea glass in a metal holder, a German railway policeman with a stamp pad and a ruler

exp_luggage_scale.what: the baggage counter's decimal platform scale (x ~150-195): a low platform with a suitcase on it, the weighing beam with two sliding weights at hand height, the counter window beside it

exp_corridor_permit.what: at the buffet (x 200-360): a family waiting, the mother holding a permit in cellophane, a boy asleep on a suitcase

exp_kiosk.what: the newspaper kiosk (x ~375-445): rows of papers with one headline, a card on a hook („vergriffen“), the man in the leather coat reading beside it

exp_green_car.what: on the next track the green windowless car (x ~530-620): barred hatches, chalk „Di – Kordon“ on the door, one hatch frosted from inside

exp_porters.what: two porters with brass badges on their caps and their luggage carts (x ~600-640)

exp_station_clock.what: the station clock under the glass roof (20.31) half in steam; a small enamel plate beside it „Ortszeit Karsk + 2“

exp_ticket_stub.what: hidden: between two platform boards near the end of platform K a small cardboard ticket stub (2 px, optional)

exp_task_basket.what: side task „Ein Korb für Frau Grabowski“: the courtyard face of the front wing, the dark kitchen window of the 2nd floor (Frau Grabowski), a basket hanging from it on a washing line down to head height (basket at y ~262)

exp_frozen_laundry.what: washing lines across the courtyard: frozen shirts, a stiff sheet, children's stockings in three sizes

exp_ilse_drawing.what: hidden: the glass pane of the side wing's stair door (beside Hanna): frost with a finger-drawn house, all its windows lit (optional, 3-4 px)

exp_task_coal.what: side task: a heap of briquettes beside the cellar hatch (delivered today), a coal shovel leaning against the hatch

exp_cellar_hatch.what: the iron cellar hatch in the pavement, open, a coal chute below; luminous arrows of the wartime shelter route inside (optional)

exp_windows.what: the lit windows of the courtyard façades = the households of the house puzzle (§2.7/§4.2): a radio and a desk lamp, a baby, a dark kitchen, a moving curtain, a card game, three sealed windows with paper strips

exp_dustbins.what: four dustbins under snow caps, white painted labels (VH, SF, HH); fir twigs sticking out of one, a chair leg out of another, one („HH 3“) empty and lined with newspaper

exp_carpet_rack.what: the iron carpet-beating rack beside the pump (x ~1630-1670) with an enamel plate of the house rules, chalk lines of a hopscotch half under snow

exp_workshop_window.what: the cobbler Pietsch's souterrain windows at the foot of the back wing (x 1700-1880), half below the pavement: shelves of shoes with name tags behind the glass (the candle after the puzzle is the env stream's art gate)
